story_clusters.headline: Why hasn't Bhagwat acted against BJP leaders who target minorities: Karnataka minister Rizwan Arshad
story_clusters.summary: Karnataka Minister Rizwan Arshad questioned why Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) chief Mohan Bhagwat has not taken action against BJP leaders who target minorities. Meanwhile, Prime Minister Narendra Modi criticized Rahul Gandhi for allegedly making false claims, while the Congress party questioned India's revised 7.8% GDP growth figure and sought details on the methodology used. Additionally, the BJP government faced criticism for allegedly protecting MP Minister Vijay Shah over his remarks about Colonel Sofiya Qureshi.

story_clusters.summary: India's GDP growth for the April-June quarter reached 7.8%, with Prime Minister Narendra Modi calling it a "herculean feat," while the opposition Congress criticized the data as a "greatly distorted picture" and questioned the revisions to previous quarterly numbers. The government has defended the growth figures, but critics argue that household savings data suggests underlying economic caution, referencing Milton Friedman’s permanent income hypothesis.
